nurse.text: Welcome to the Birmingham Sanctuary. You are in the right place, bab. Pop your team on the counter, I'll put the kettle on while we're at it.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Right, let's have a look. Bostin little team you've got here.
All done, good as new. Tara-a-bit! And mind the canal, it's wetter than it looks.
The Ark terminal. It was built in a repurposed custard factory. The terminal is fine. The custard is only a rumour.

else.text: No bother. Come in and put your feet up. There's tea in the pot, and it's still warm. Probably.
